warnings.description: 8 of 78 groups have n<5 reviews (min n=1: Spas/Australia & Oceania 5.0, Speciality Museums/America 5.0); their Avg_Rating is statistically fragile. 2 groups are singletons. This is a data-density property of the source, not an output defect - values are correct means, just low-confidence.

Visa_Free_Score is the outbound visa-free access of the Indonesian passport (mobility of the destination's residents), not Indonesia's inbound visa openness, and GDP per capita comes from a ~2006 World-Bank-style snapshot. Both are single-destination constants, so they cannot vary with AttractionType/Continent and only serve as contextual annotation - any correlation with Avg_Rating across rows is not identifiable.
